$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema, or the page stops showing after a build. Every input below returned rows in a local run on 2026-11-03 (engine branch platform/smartrecruiters), and the companies each description names were among its rows; the software engineer, Bosch and link-check inputs ran again on engine v0.4.0 with the same result. options.memoryMbytes follows defaultRunOptions in store.json (TODO_DEPLOYED: the measured default).

tasks.seoDescription: Jobs published on SmartRecruiters career sites in the last day, newest first, with company, location, work type and link. Run it daily for a fresh feed.
